NAMESURFER_BASE_URL.title: NAMESURFER_BASE_URL
NAMESURFER_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of NameSurfer API (jsonrpc10) endpoint URL (e.g., https://foo.example.com:8443/API/NSService_10)

NAMESURFER_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.title: NAMESURFER_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY
NAMESURFER_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.description: Whether to verify the API certificate

NAMESURFER_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: NAMESURFER_POLLING_INTERVAL
NAMESURFER_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

NAMESURFER_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: NAMESURFER_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
NAMESURFER_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 120)

NAMESURFER_TTL.title: NAMESURFER_TTL
NAMESURFER_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 300)

NAMESURFER_VIEW.title: NAMESURFER_VIEW
NAMESURFER_VIEW.description: DNS view name (optional, default: empty string)
